sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can form the past tense of regular verbs, indefinite and definite, in all persons.
I can use the irregular past-tense verbs volt, ment, jött, evett/ette and ivott/itta.
I can tell a short connected story about a specific day using tegnap, múlt hétvégén and aztán.
